primary_source_rule: Every selected lesson's primary URL is an official Fortinet administration, configuration, new-feature, deployment or release source. Community material is used only for operational scenarios and failure evidence.
notes: Searches were performed across all twelve product areas; no recent result is fabricated where none was verified.
